title: Supplementary code for: Topological Certificates of Redundant Coverage for Cortical Electrode Arrays
description: Python implementation of the k-shadow nerve theorem and every computation reported in the paper: exact nerves of disk and geodesic footprint families, k-shadow and subdivision complexes with GF(2) Betti numbers, the redundancy barcode, the discrete disk test, the cortical-surface benchmark on the FieldTrip colin27 template, and the optimal-coverage design search with its covering-radius and packing bounds, and the analysis of real contact failures on a 64-channel EEG cap (OpenNeuro ds003775) with an exact arrangement check of the certificate.

creators.name: Bose, Aditi
creators.affiliation: International Institute of Information Technology, Hyderabad
